title.zh: 做一个全球实时灾难雷达

tagline.zh: 把正在发生的自然灾害与人文灾害放到一张世界地图上，让危险程度一眼可见。
tagline.en: Put ongoing natural and human-made disasters on one world map and make severity understandable at a glance.

brief.zh: 使用公开、可追溯的数据源，做一个真正能帮助普通人理解全球正在发生什么的灾难地图。你可以从热区、事件图标、风险评分、新闻摘要、历史趋势或任何你认为更有效的方向切入。
brief.en: Use public, traceable data sources to build a disaster map that helps ordinary people understand what is happening around the world. Explore heat zones, event icons, severity scoring, news summaries, historical trends, or a better approach of your own.

zh: 一句话说明你的核心思路
使用的 AI / 开发工具
en: One sentence explaining your core approach
The AI / development tools you used

title.zh: 把一本书变成 Agent 真正能用的 Skill
title.en: Turn a Book into a Skill an Agent Can Actually Use

tagline.zh: 不要只总结一本书，而是把其中可复用的方法、判断规则和流程变成 Agent 能调用的能力。
tagline.en: Do not merely summarize a book—turn its reusable methods, decision rules, and workflows into capabilities an agent can invoke.

brief.zh: 选择任意一本非受限内容的书，先判断它属于什么类型，再设计一种把核心知识转成结构化 Skill 的方法。重点不是压缩文本，而是证明这个 Skill 在真实任务里比普通摘要更有用。
brief.en: Choose any non-restricted book, classify what kind of knowledge it contains, and design a way to turn its core ideas into a structured Skill. The goal is not text compression; prove the Skill is more useful than a normal summary on real tasks.

zh: 可运行的 Skill / Agent Demo
输入书籍与输出 Skill 的说明
至少一个真实使用案例
en: An explanation of book input and Skill output
At least one real usage example

title.zh: 做一个不能聊天、只能轻轻 Ping 对方的双人产品
title.en: Build a Two-Person Product That Can Ping but Cannot Chat

tagline.zh: 如果两个人不打开聊天框，也能表达“我在想你”“到家告诉我”“现在需要你”，会是什么体验？
tagline.en: What if two people could say “thinking of you,” “tell me when you get home,” or “I need you” without opening a chat?

brief.zh: 设计一个极轻量的双人沟通产品。它不能退化成普通聊天软件，必须用更少的动作、更低的打扰完成情绪或状态表达。网页、桌面组件、手表、小程序或你想到的任何载体都可以。
brief.en: Design an ultra-light two-person communication product. It must not collapse into ordinary messaging; use fewer actions and less interruption to communicate emotion or status. Web, desktop widgets, watches, mini apps, or any medium are welcome.

zh: 你刻意没有加入什么功能
至少一个真实使用场景
en: An explanation of the core interaction
At least one real usage scenario

title.zh: 做一个两个人和 AI 一起玩的推理游戏
title.en: Build a Two-Player Detective Game Powered by AI

tagline.zh: 两名真人玩家不是和固定剧本对答案，而是与一个会回应、会隐藏信息、会推动故事的 AI 世界互动。
tagline.en: Two human players should not solve a fixed script; they should interact with an AI world that responds, hides information, and advances the story.

brief.zh: 做一个能在网页上直接开始的双人推理体验。AI 可以扮演主持人、嫌疑人、世界规则或动态生成案件，但游戏必须有清晰的胜负或推理闭环，而不是无限聊天。
brief.en: Build a two-player detective experience that can start directly on the web. AI may act as host, suspect, world rules, or dynamic case generator, but the game needs a clear deduction loop or win condition rather than endless chat.

zh: 可双人体验的 Live Demo
AI 在游戏中承担的角色
防止无限聊天或失控的机制
en: A live demo playable by two people
The basic flow of one session
The role AI plays in the game
A mechanism that prevents endless or uncontrolled chat
